issues.description: Field 'numberOfLecturers': the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares numberOfLecturers as type int, the template Lecture.java contains a TODO to add the attributes but does not declare the field, and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares the backing field as byte and uses byte in the constructor parameter and setter parameter while the solution getter is declared to return int. This inconsistent typing (UML: int vs solution field/setter: byte, solution getter: int) can confuse students about which type to implement and leads to mismatched signatures between constructor/setter and getter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent with the problem statement UML by using int everywhere. Concretely, in the solution (and any tests) change the field declaration to 'private int numberOfLecturers;', update the constructor parameter to 'int numberOfLecturers', and update the setter parameter to 'int numberOfLecturers'. Keep the getter return type as int. Alternatively, if the intent is to restrict the value to a byte, update the problem statement UML to show byte and document the narrower type, but prefer using int to match the UML as currently specified.
